reviews.title: Shockingly good quality for the price!
reviews.comment:
For under $15, this mouse pad is honestly impressive. The size alone is fantastic — it easily covers keyboard and mouse with room to spare — but what surprised me most is the quality.
The surface is smooth and consistent, tracking is excellent, and the pad lays flat right out of the box with no annoying curl. Stitching around the edges is clean, the rubber base grips well, and the print quality of the map looks sharp and professional, not cheap or blurry.
I fully expected “good enough” at this price. Instead, it feels like something that should cost significantly more. It performs just as well as pads I’ve paid 2–3× the price for.
If you want an oversized desk mat that looks good, performs well, and doesn’t feel like a disposable accessory, this is an easy buy.

reviews.title: Great Pad, Great Price
reviews.comment:
Simple design, does what you'd expect, has a nice feel to it, and all at a great price.
There are a number of these large mouse pads on Amazon - same size, same appearance/design, same threading, and very similar price. I would suspect they all come from the same manufacturer and are in fact the same one just sold under different brands. However, after going through several of them, I have found that this one - the Cmhoo XXL - definitely feels smoother than the others straight out of the box. Some of the other ones that look identical still have a slightly rougher surface. Nothing crazy, but they often leave my wrists or hands feeling warm, or even cause a slight rug burn, and usually take a few months until they're worn in and smoothed over a bit. The Cmhoo XXL is slightly smoother and does not have those issues. It's definitely the best in this size/price category.
One recommendation I would make is to get a horsehair brush and a spray bottle of isopropyl alcohol for cleaning it. I often eat at my desk or do other things, and it's not unusual to get dirt or other stuff smudged against it. A horsehair brush is stiff enough to rub anything off, but soft enough that it won't damage it. Combined with isopropyl alcohol it will easily lift up anything, keeping your mat clean. Otherwise these things will get very dirty over time, no matter how clean you are.
My only complaint is that despite having the anti-slip bottom, it can and still will shift forward on the far right, where I move the mouse around. Though to be fair this happens with all mats of this type. Because of this I'll usually put a strip of velcro underneath where my wrist would be, sticking one side to the desk and one side to the mat, so it cannot move. The slight bump it creates also acts as a makeshift wrist-rest for the mouse as well.
